SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
WHERE s.Virtual = 'F'
AND ss.AvgScrMath > 400;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
WHERE s.Virtual = 'F'
AND ss.AvgScrMath > 400;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
WHERE s.Virtual = 'F'
AND ss.AvgScrMath > 400;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.AvgScrMath > 400 AND T2.Virtual = 'V';

SELECT COUNT(s.CDSCode)
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sa ON s.CDSCode = sa.cds
WHERE sa.AvgScrMath > 400 AND s.Virtual = 'V';

SELECT COUNT(s.CDSCode)
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sa ON s.CDSCode = sa.cds
WHERE sa.AvgScrMath > 400 AND s.Virtual = 'V';

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
WHERE s.Virtual = 'P'
AND s.Charter = 0
AND AVG(ss.AvgScrMath) > 400;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
WHERE s.Virtual = 'P'
AND ss.AvgScrMath > 400;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
WHERE s.Virtual = 'F'
AND ss.AvgScrMath > 400;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
WHERE s.Virtual = 'F'
AND ss.AvgScrMath > 400;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
WHERE s.Virtual = 'F'
AND ss.AvgScrMath > 400;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
WHERE s.Virtual = 'P'
GROUP BY s.School
HAVING AVG(ss.AvgScrMath) > 400;

SELECT COUNT(s.CDSCode)
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sa ON s.CDSCode = sa.cds
WHERE s.Virtual = 'P'
GROUP BY s.CDSCode
HAVING AVG(sa.AvgScrMath) > 400;

SELECT COUNT(s.CDSCode)
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sa ON s.School = sa.sname
WHERE s.Virtual = 'P'
GROUP BY s.CDSCode
HAVING AVG(sa.AvgScrMath) > 400;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
JOIN satscores sa ON s.School = sa.sname
WHERE sa.AvgScrMath > 400 AND s.Virtual = 'P';
